COD.rationale: Content coordinate, organizational pattern (coordinate set) and an explicit origin/status entry co-occur for the same p0/current/n0 referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify content attributes (color) bound to named referents and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Separate 'origin' metadata entries distinguish content identity from its status/origin across referents and times.

O.rationale: Entries explicitly present how content is organized/presented as coordinate sets for named referents and times.
